comment: Exported symbols with zero non-test reference in this module and in an external consumer checkout, when one is checked via --sibling or SDK_CONSUMER_PATH, declared on purpose. This repo is a public SDK and does not name a specific consumer here. check_symbol_wiring.py fails on any such symbol missing here, or on a stale entry: one whose symbol no longer appears in any api/*.txt lock, or one that has gained a real caller since the entry was written. permanent=false means an internal or external caller is expected later, named in target. permanent=true means the symbol is public SDK surface meant for external application code with no current consumer, matching the same convention as policy/pending_wiring.json's package-level entries.
